title: Claim creation on an existing policy up to payments

presentation.note: Headed demo: banners at the main steps, held pauseAfterBannerMs; slowMoMs is a short delay before every click and keystroke. PRESENTATION=off turns both off.

policy.note: Tried in order: the first one that is found, belongs to the insured, is in force on the loss date and lists a vehicle is used. CC_POLICY_NUMBER puts another policy first. A candidate may set "vehicle"; otherwise the first vehicle on the policy is used.

reserve.note: The reserve the payments are made from. ClaimCenter normally creates it with the Vehicle exposure; if the claim has none (or less than the payment), the test sets it to this amount. CC_RESERVE_CATEGORY uses another cost category.

payment.note: One check of this amount from the reserve line; the reserve goes down by the same amount.
